content: Swift Calendar API: Calendar.current caches timezone; Calendar.autoupdatingCurrent tracks user timezone changes. Calendar arithmetic (date(byAdding:) with .day/.hour components) is DST-aware; raw TimeInterval arithmetic (Date + 604800) is NOT. WWDC21 Foundation session explicitly warns: 'For calculations that are in terms of hours, days, etc., please use Calendar API' (i.e., a 168-hour cycle != 7 calendar days across DST). Calendar.RepeatedTimePolicy exists specifically because DST transitions repeat/omit wall-clock times. MatchingPolicy controls nextDate search. Pitfall: using fixed 604800-second intervals or DateComponents without calendar for 7-day reset cycles produces drift.
